Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:10:1.english: Who stands firm regarding coins - He holds himself back from accepting them when he finds a flaw in them.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:11:1.hebrew: מסייע ליה - מתני' דקתני נותנה למעשר שני:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:11:1.english: Supports him - the Mishnah, which teaches: "one gives it for second tithe."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:11:2.english: He comes to change it - He comes to exchange a deficient sela for perutot.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:11:3.hebrew: פורטה בשויה - לפי חסרונה, ולא ירמה את חבירו לפורטה ביפה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:11:3.english: He changes it for its value - according to its deficiency, and he may not deceive his fellow [by] changing it as an unflawed [coin].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:11:4.english: [If he] comes to desacralize it - To desacralize second tithe upon it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:11:5.english: He desacralizes upon it - [second] tithe at the value of a good [unflawed] sela.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:11:6.english: With a good [coin] - As if it were a good [coin].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:12:1.hebrew: מאי קאמר - בא לפורטה, פורטה בשויה — מתניתין אתא לאשמועינן! דכיון דפיחתה כדי אונאה, אסור להוציאה ביפה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:12:1.english: What is he saying - [That when] he comes to change it, he changes it for its [actual] value — [this is what] our Mishnah came to teach us! For since it depreciated by the threshold of fraud (ona'ah), it is forbidden to spend it as an unflawed [coin].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:12:2.hebrew: ה"ק - אע"פ שכשבא לפורטה בירושלים בפרוטות ליקח סעודת מעשר, על כרחו יפרטנה בשויה ולא ביפה; אפילו הכי סלע שמה, שאינה אלא נפש רעה, וכשחילל מעשר עליה מחלל ביפה. ואשמועינן חזקיה דמתני' דקתני "נותנה למעשר שני", כאילו היא יפה קאמר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:12:2.english: This is what he is saying - Although when he comes to change it in Jerusalem into perutot to buy a [second] tithe meal, he will perforce change it at its [actual] value and not as an unflawed [coin], nevertheless it is [still] called a sela, for it is merely [due to] a stingy person; and when he desacralizes [second] tithe upon it, he desacralizes [it] as an unflawed [coin]. And Chizkiyah teaches us that the Mishnah, which teaches, "He gives it for second tithe," means [he gives it] as though it were unflawed.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:13:1.english: That we treat [second tithe] with contempt - [by] being exact [with] the money of its redemption.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:13:2.hebrew: שאין בו שוה פרוטה - ואין בו כח לתפוס פדיונו, שיתן פרוטה ויחללנה, כדאמר לקמן: ממעשרו — ולא כל מעשר כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:13:2.english: That does not have the value of a peruta - And it does not have the capacity to effect its redemption, [such] that one could give a peruta and desacralize it, as [the Gemara] says later: "[from] his tithe" — and not all tithe, etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:13:3.english: He says: It and its fifth - that I must add to it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:13:4.hebrew: יהא מחולל על מעות הראשונות - שחיללתי עליה מעשר שני ועודן בידי, יהא אף זה מחולל על אותו מעשר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:13:4.english: Let it be desacralized upon the first coins - [Coins] upon which I desacralized second tithe and which are still in my hand — let this too be desacralized upon that [same] tithe.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:13:5.hebrew: שאי אפשר לאדם לצמצם מעותיו - לחלל בשווין בצמצום, שמתוך שהוא ירא מלפחות ונמצא אוכלו בלא חילוף, הוא מוסיף על דמיו. הילכך, פחות משוה פרוטה זה מחלל על אותו עודף. אלמא לא פרקינן בצמצום, וכ"ש בפחות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:13:5.english: That it is impossible for a person to be precise with his coins - To desacralize [second-tithe produce] at its exact value; for since he is afraid of undervaluing [it] and thereby ending up eating it without [valid] exchange, he adds [extra] to its value. Therefore, he desacralizes this [produce worth] less than a peruta upon that excess. Thus, we do not redeem [second-tithe produce] at its exact value, and all the more so not for less.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:14:1.hebrew: בתורת יפה - בשויה. וה"ק: כשם שכשבא לפורטה בירושלים, לא יקבלוה הימנו להדיא אלא בשויה, ויש מזלזלין בדמיה יותר מכדי פחתה, כך כשבא לחללה, מחללה בשויה, דמים פחותים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:14:1.english: With the status of an unflawed [coin] - According to its [actual] value. And this is what [the Gemara] means: Just as when he comes to change it in Jerusalem, they will not accept it from him at face value, but rather according to its [actual] value — and some [people] undervalue it by more than the amount of its erosion — so too, when he comes to redeem [second-tithe produce] with it, he redeems [it] with it according to its [actual] value, [at] diminished value.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:14:2.hebrew: בתורת יפה - משחלל עליה כפי דמים ודאין שלה, כך לא יחלל על זו אלא בדמים ודאין שלה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:14:2.english: With the status of a good [coin] - Just as [one] redeems [second tithe] upon [a good coin] according to its definite value, so too, he may only redeem upon this [eroded coin] according to its definite value.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:14:3.hebrew: דתרי זילי לא מזלזלינן ביה - דאע"ג דתנן נותן למעשר שני, חד זילותא אשמועינן, דמתחלל על סלע חסירה, ולא אמרינן הרי הוא כאסימון או כמעות הניתנות באסימון. אבל תרי זילי — לחלל עליה מעשר בדמי סלע יפה — לא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:14:3.english: For we do not treat it with two [forms of] contempt - For although we learned [in the Mishnah], "One may give [it] for second tithe," it teaches us one [form of] contempt — that [second tithe] may be desacralized upon a deficient sela, and we do not say that it is like an unminted slug or like coins given as an unminted slug. However, two [forms of] contempt — to desacralize [second] tithe upon it at the value of an unflawed sela — no.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:16:1.hebrew: ביכורים - הוקשו לתרומה, דקרינהו רחמנא תרומה, דאמר מר (מכות דף יז.): "ותרומת ידך" — אלו ביכורים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:16:1.english: First fruits - They are compared to teruma, for the Merciful One [i.e., Scripture] called them teruma, as the Master said (Makkot 17a): "And the offering of your hand" — these are first fruits.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:16:2.english: [They] are liable to death for them - A non-priest or an impure priest who eats it intentionally.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:16:3.hebrew: וחומש - זר האוכלן בשוגג, דכתיב (ויקרא כ״ב:י״ד) ואיש כי יאכל קדש בשגגה וגו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:16:3.english: And a fifth - [This refers to] a non-priest who eats them unwittingly, as it is written (Leviticus 22:14): "And if a man eats of a holy thing unwittingly, etc."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:1:1.hebrew: יתר על כן מוכרה בשויה - לעיל קתני לה גבי סלע שפיחתה, מוכרה בשויה — לפי דמיה ולא ביפה. אלמא מותר לקיימה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:1:1.english: Greater than that, he may sell it at its value - Above, it teaches this regarding a sela that eroded: he may sell it at its value — according to its [actual] worth, and not as a good [coin]. Thus, it is permitted to retain it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:1:2.hebrew: יתר על כן - על כדי אונאה, דלא פחתה כדי אונאה לכל חד וחד כדאית ליה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:1:2.english: Greater than that - [Greater] than the measure of exploitation, [meaning] that it has not eroded [to] the measure of exploitation, for each and every one according to his [opinion].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:1:3.english: He may sell it at its value - As a good [coin].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:2:1.hebrew: מאי לאו דפחת' פורתא פורתא - וקאמר מותר לקיימה עד שקל, אלמא לא מיחלפא בסלע, ותיובתא דרב הונא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:2:1.english: Does [this] not [mean] that it eroded little by little - And it states [that] it is permitted to keep it up to a shekel; thus it is not confused with a sela, and [this is] a refutation of Rav Huna.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:3:1.english: His scraps - Broken pieces of silver vessels.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:3:2.hebrew: מן הצד לא יקבנה - לפי שהרמאי שימצאנה יקוץ אותה סביב עד שיוציא את הנקב, ומרמה בה את האחרים ויוציאנה בשקל:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:3:2.english: From the side, he should not perforate it - Because a swindler who finds it will cut around it until he removes the hole, and deceive others with it and spend it as a shekel.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:3:3.hebrew: ה"ג או יקוץ או יתוך - לשון התכה, ולא גרסינן יחתוך:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:3:3.english: This is our reading: Or he should cut [it], or he should melt [it] - [Yatokh is] an expression of melting, and we do not read yachatokh [he should cut].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:4:1.english: In the middle - he should perforate it, for once he has perforated it, it does not circulate [as currency].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:5:1.english: Whereby he distinguishes - Between villages and cities.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:5:2.hebrew: ומאי שנא טלית דלא מפליג - דקתני בכדי שיראה לתגר או לקרובו, לא שנא כרך לא שנא כפר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:5:2.english: And what is different [regarding] a garment, whereby he does not distinguish - For [the Mishnah] teaches: "within [the time] that he can show [it] to a merchant or to his relative" — whether [in] a city [or] whether [in] a village.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:6:1.english: When they go up to the market - To buy what is needed for the Shabbat meal.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:8:1.hebrew: מדת חסידות - וה"ק: אם חסיד הוא, מקבלה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:8:1.english: An attribute of piety - And this is what [the Mishnah] is saying: If he is pious, he accepts it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:8:2.english: For whom - Who is the one complaining?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:8:3.hebrew: אם לחסיד - קאמר דיש לו תרעומת על המחזיר, מי כופהו לקבל שיתרעם? טוב לו שלא יקבלנה משיקבלנה ויוציא דיבה על חבירו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:8:3.english: If [it refers] to the pious one - [the Mishnah] says that he has a grievance against the one returning [the coin]: who forces him to accept [it] that he should have a grievance? It is better for him not to accept it than to accept it and spread a bad report about his fellow.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:9:1.hebrew: ואחר שאינו חסיד - ולא רצה לקבלה, אין לזה עליו אלא תרעומת, דאיהו הוא דאפסיד אנפשיה שלא החזירו בזמנו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 52b:9:1.english: And another [person] who is not pious - and did not want to accept it [back], this one has only a grievance against him, for he is the one who caused the loss to himself by not returning it within its [allotted] time.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 52b:10:1.hebrew: נותנה למעשר שני - אחסרה כדי אונאה קאי, ונותנה למעשר שני בשויה, ואינו חושש משום אסימון, דשם מטבע יש עליה, דמי שאינו לוקחה בשויה בתורת מטבע, כי אם כמו נסכא, אינו אלא נפש רעה; ורב פפא בא להוסיף אפילו שאר מטבעות. "מסייע ליה לחזקיה דאמר מחללה ביפה" — פי': כאילו מתחילה היתה כן ולא חסרה, דהיינו בשויה; דאי ממתני', ה"א: נותנה למעשר שני בפחות משויה, משום דנפש רעה אינו מקבלה בשויה בתורת מטבע, וקמ"ל דלא מיקרי אסימון, משום דמי שאינו לוקחה אינו אלא נפש רעה. קמ"ל חזקיה דמחללה ביפה, כאילו היתה מתחילה כך, דכ"ע הכי שקלי לה, והיינו בשויה ממש. ופריך: דאין לצמצם ולחלל בשויה! ומשני: בתורת יפה; כלומר, שמחלל בפחות מעט, משום דאין יכול לצמצם, כמו ביפה, שמחלל כמו כן בפחות מעט. והרב רבי יצחק בן הרב ר' מאיר מפרש דקאי אפחות מכדי אונאה, ונותנה למעשר שני בסלע שלם, שאינו אלא נפש רעה מי שאינו מקבלה בסלע שלם. "מסייע ליה לחזקיה דאמר" — אע"פ שפורטה לשולחני בשויה ולא בסלע שלם, לפי שהוא מדקדק יותר, אפי' הכי מחלל ביפה בסלע שלם, דאזלינן בתר שאר בני אדם שאינם מדקדקים ומקבלין אותה בסלע שלם; והשתא הוי "ביפה" כמשמעו. ופריך: והא אמר חזקיה "לפי שאי אפשר לצמצם"! ומשני: בתורת יפה; כלומר, פחות מעט מסלע שלם, כמו אם לא חסרה כלל היה מחלל עליה פחות מעט. וקא משמע לן חזקיה דמחללה ביפה; דאי ממתני', ה"א: נותנה למעשר שני בשויה, כמו שיתן עליה שולחני, לפי שאינו אלא נפש רעה למי שאינו מקבלה בשלם, א"כ לא הוי אסימון. והריב"ן פי': נותנה למעשר שני בסלע שלם אותה שחסרה כדי אונאה. וקשה: דאמאי הוי נפש רעה אותו שאינו מקבלה? הלא חייב להחזיר האונאה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 52b:10:1.english: One may give it for second tithe - [The Mishnah] refers to [a coin] that has eroded by the threshold of overcharge [kedei ona'ah], and one gives it for second tithe at its [actual] value, and need not be concerned about [it being considered] an unminted slug [asimon], for it still has the status of a coin; as one who does not take it at its [actual] value as a coin, but only as bullion, is merely a miserly soul; and Rav Pappa comes to add even other coins. "This supports Ḥizkiyya, who said: He desacralizes [produce] with it as an unflawed [coin]" — the explanation is: as if it had been like this from the beginning and had not eroded, meaning at its [actual] value; for if [we only had] the Mishnah, I would have said: he gives it for second tithe for less than its [actual] value, because a miserly soul does not accept it at its [actual] value as a coin, and [the Mishnah] teaches us that it is not called an asimon, because one who does not take it is merely a miserly soul. [Therefore] Ḥizkiyya teaches us that he desacralizes [produce] with it as an unflawed [coin], as if it had been like this from the beginning, for everyone takes it this way, and that is at its exact [actual] value. And [the Gemara] asks: that one may not be exact and desacralize at its [exact] value! And [the Gemara] answers: in the manner of an unflawed [coin]; that is to say, he desacralizes slightly less [produce than the coin's value], because he cannot be exact, just as with an unflawed [coin], where he likewise desacralizes slightly less [produce]. And Rabbi Yitzḥak son of Rabbi Meir explains that [the Mishnah] refers to [a coin that eroded] less than the threshold of overcharge, and he gives it for second tithe as a full sela, for one who does not accept it as a full sela is merely a miserly soul. "This supports Ḥizkiyya, who said" — even though he changes it with a moneychanger at its [actual] value and not as a full sela, because [a moneychanger] is more exacting, nevertheless he desacralizes [produce] with it as an unflawed [coin], as a full sela, for we follow the rest of the people, who are not exacting and accept it as a full sela; and now "as an unflawed [coin]" is [understood] literally. And [the Gemara] asks: But didn't Ḥizkiyya say "because it is impossible to be exact"! And [the Gemara] answers: in the manner of an unflawed [coin]; that is to say, [he desacralizes] slightly less than a full sela, just as if it had not eroded at all he would desacralize slightly less upon it. And Ḥizkiyya teaches us that he desacralizes [produce] with it as an unflawed [coin]; for if [we only had] the Mishnah, I would have said: he gives it for second tithe at its [actual] value, like what a moneychanger would give for it, [and] because one who does not accept it as a whole [coin] is merely a miserly soul, therefore it is not an asimon. And the Rivan [Rabbi Yehudah ben Natan] explained: he gives that [coin] which has eroded by the threshold of overcharge for second tithe as a full sela. And this is difficult: why is one who does not accept it [considered] a miserly soul? Is he not obligated to return the overcharge?!

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 52b:3:1.hebrew: שיהא שוקל בה משקלות - וא"ת דהכא משמע שעושי' משקל בשל מתכת, ובהמוכר את הספינה (ב"ב דף פט: ושם ד"ה ולא) אמרינן: אין עושין משקלות משל מתכת? וי"ל, דדוקא לשקול בשר ושמן — שהלחלוחית נדבק בהם ומתיבש ומכביד — אסור; אבל לשקול בהם כסף וזהב — שרי, אלא צריך לחופן בעור שלא ישחקו, כדאיתא פ' המביא תניין (גיטין כב. ושם): שלשה עורות הן כו' כדי לצור בו משקולת קטנה; והיינו של מתכת, דמחפים אותה בעור:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 52b:3:1.english: That he would weigh weights with it - And if you will ask: here it implies that one makes a weight out of metal, whereas in [the chapter] HaMokher Et HaSefinah (Bava Batra 89b, and there, s.v. "Velo"), we say [that] one does not make weights out of metal! One can answer that specifically for weighing meat and oil — where the moisture adheres to them, dries out, and makes [the weight] heavier — it is forbidden; however, to weigh silver and gold with them is permitted, except that one must cover them in leather so that they do not wear down, as it is [stated] in the chapter HaMevi Tinyan (Gittin 22a, and there): "There are three [types of] hides, etc., in order to wrap a small weight in it"; and that refers to [a weight] of metal, which they cover in leather.
